evidence.quote: You can use an unlimited number of folders and up to 8 levels of nesting.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The $19 tier lacks 6 of 8 features in the $38 tier.

evidence.quote: Plan 1 ($19): 1 user; 1 device; Unlimited local workspaces

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $19 vs a stated $199 regular price (90% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

trials.claim: Each code after 3 codes adds 1 additional user
trials.claimQuote: Each code after 3 codes adds 1 additional user
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence about how additional codes affect the number of users.

trials.claim: Includes all future Personal, Cloud, or Team Plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Personal (Tier 1), Cloud (Tier 2), or Team (Tier 3+) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The vendor states the license can be used for an unlimited time and a buyer reports new features are added weekly. The expiry and renewal quotes do not show deal buyers being charged or moved to a paid plan, so they do not undercut the deal promise.

exhibits.quote: After the license expires, the application will not be able to send requests,
exhibits.argument: The license can expire and disable core sending, which contradicts lifetime access with all future updates included.

exhibits.quote: but all other functions will be available. You can renew your license here with a
exhibits.argument: Requiring a paid renewal undermines the promise of all future plan updates at no extra cost.

exhibits.quote: to use NativeRest for an unlimited time after purchasing the license.
exhibits.argument: The vendor promises unlimited-time use after purchase, supporting lifetime plan updates.

exhibits.quote: New features are added weekly, bugs are fixed quickly.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms ongoing new features and fixes, supporting future updates.

trials.claim: Create, debug and test API with fast lightweight client for Windows, macOS and Linux
trials.claimQuote: Create, debug and test your API with a fast and lightweight API-client for Windows, macOS and Linux
trials.reasoning: The vendor directly describes NativeRest as a REST API client for Windows, macOS and Linux, and a buyer confirms it worked well on Windows and macOS. The Windows activation quote does not show that macOS or Linux versions are unavailable.

exhibits.quote: A license key allows you to activate the Premium version on Windows device.
exhibits.argument: Limiting activation to a Windows device undermines the claim of full client availability for macOS and Linux.

exhibits.quote: Native REST API client for Windows, macOS and Linux
exhibits.argument: Vendor directly states it is a REST API client for Windows, macOS and Linux.

exhibits.quote: So far it has worked well on both Windows and macOS.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the client works on both Windows and macOS.

themes.summary: Several buyers say the developer responds quickly and implements requests within days.

hits.quote: quickly after I received email that he's going to look into it, really nice.
The developer is very responsive and has even added some of the features I requested.
New features are added weekly, bugs are fixed quickly.
Support is very responsive when needed.
The support is really incredibly good, and requests/suggestions for further developments are taken on board
even replying on a Sunday! He has already sorted out my two bugs within the week.
The support team is clear and very helpful.

themes.summary: Many reviewers say the app is fast, lightweight, and works well as a Postman alternative.

hits.quote: I’ve found this tool to be exceptionally useful and it’s performing admirably on my Windows laptop.
So far it has worked well on both Windows and macOS.
It really does what it claims. 1000% faster than Insomnia and Postman.
I never seen such a fast app on Windows, it installed and launched in 0.05 seconds.
Native rest is simple, fast and works great on Mac!
Very pleased with this app (working perfectly in Linux).

themes.summary: Buyers call it an affordable one-time alternative without predatory subscriptions.

hits.quote: On top of that, the price is super affordable.
without predatory subscriptions and artificial limitations, then this is it.
better buy it cheap check the functionalities and step up to the next size.

themes.summary: Even happy reviewers request folders, collection runner, and console for troubleshooting.

hits.quote: Organizing API routes into folders for better management.
the possibility to run collections / have the runner of Postman (I see it is in work for NativeRest)
I wish that it had a Console tab like on Insomnia for help in troubleshooting routing and redirects.

themes.summary: One reviewer notes cloud sync works but is not always fast.

hits.quote: It works, but it isn't always the fastest.
